description: Shared immutable DTOs that both the recognition and routing paths build on: Landmark (P0-08) and RouteResult (P0-09, P0-10, P0-12). Dependency-free, no package imports. Foundation feature — must come first because routing_service.dart (FEAT-003) imports route_result.dart and both test files reference these types. Independent of FEAT-002.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/plan.md 'Decided public API' sections for landmark.dart and route_result.dart and the data contracts; read lib/features/recognition/embedding_service.dart and test/embedding_service_test.dart for exact style.

Create lib/shared/models/landmark.dart: immutable Landmark{id,name,lat,lon(double),routeNodeId(String)} with const constructor; factory Landmark.fromJson(Map<String,dynamic>) reading keys id,name,lat,lon,route_node_id, casting lat/lon via num then toDouble, throwing FormatException on blank id/name/route_node_id (after trim), lat not in [-90,90], lon not in [-180,180], or non-finite/non-num coords; static List<Landmark> listFromJsonString(String) that jsonDecode-s a top-level List, maps each element through fromJson, rejects duplicate ids with FormatException, returns growable:false list in file order. Imports: dart:convert only.

Create lib/shared/models/route_result.dart: typedef GeoPoint = (double lat, double lon); class RouteResult with const RouteResult.available({required List<GeoPoint> geometry, required double distanceMeters}) setting isAvailable=true, const RouteResult.unavailable() setting geometry=const[], distanceMeters=0, isAvailable=false; fields geometry, distanceMeters, isAvailable; static const double metersPerMinute=75.0; double get etaMinutes => isAvailable ? distanceMeters/metersPerMinute : 0.0. Dependency-free (no imports).

Create test/landmark_test.dart (plain test(...) style, package:flutter_test + package:tuntun/shared/models/landmark.dart): valid fromJson; integer lat/lon accepted; blank id/name/route_node_id rejected; lat 90.1 and lon 180.1 rejected; NaN/Infinity rejected; listFromJsonString preserves order; duplicate-id string rejected; load real assets/landmarks/landmarks.json via dart:io File(...).readAsStringSync() and assert 6 landmarks, first id fort-santiago, route_node_id 1034882636.

Create test/route_result_test.dart: available holds geometry+distance; etaMinutes 150m=>2.0, 75m=>1.0; unavailable() has isAvailable==false, empty geometry, etaMinutes==0.0, and is distinct from available(geometry:[p],distanceMeters:0) which has isAvailable==true.
acceptance_criteria: flutter analyze on lib/shared/models/landmark.dart and lib/shared/models/route_result.dart reports no errors
flutter test test/landmark_test.dart passes all tests including the real-asset case asserting 6 landmarks and first id fort-santiago
flutter test test/route_result_test.dart passes including ETA 150m=>2.0 and the unavailable-vs-zero-length distinction
findings:
Created lib/shared/models/landmark.dart and lib/shared/models/route_result.dart, both dependency-free (landmark.dart imports dart:convert only; route_result.dart has no imports). Exact exported API:

route_result.dart (imported by FEAT-003 routing_service.dart):
- typedef GeoPoint = (double lat, double lon)  // record, [latitude, longitude] order matching graph convention; NOT latlong2.
- class RouteResult:
  - const RouteResult.available({required List<GeoPoint> geometry, required double distanceMeters})  // sets isAvailable=true.
  - const RouteResult.unavailable()  // geometry=const <GeoPoint>[], distanceMeters=0, isAvailable=false. First-class P0-12 no-path state (not a zero-length route, not a straight line).
  - final List<GeoPoint> geometry;
  - final double distanceMeters;
  - final bool isAvailable;
  - static const double metersPerMinute = 75.0;
  - double get etaMinutes => isAvailable ? distanceMeters / metersPerMinute : 0.0;  // unavailable => 0.0.
  FEAT-003 (routing_service) should: import 'package:tuntun/shared/models/route_result.dart'; return RouteResult.available(geometry: <concatenated edge geometry as List<GeoPoint>>, distanceMeters: <summed length_m>) on success, RouteResult.unavailable() for a valid-but-disconnected pair, and build geometry as List<GeoPoint> in [lat,lon] order (no axis swap needed since GeoPoint is (lat, lon)). start==destination => available single-point zero-distance route.

landmark.dart:
- class Landmark { const Landmark({required String id, required String name, required double lat, required double lon, required String routeNodeId}); final String id; final String name; final double lat; final double lon; final String routeNodeId; }
  - factory Landmark.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json)  // keys id,name,lat,lon,route_node_id; num->toDouble so integer coords accepted; FormatException on blank id/name/route_node_id (trimmed), lat not in [-90,90], lon not in [-180,180], non-finite/non-num coords.
  - static List<Landmark> listFromJsonString(String jsonString)  // top-level JSON List, each element a Map, each via fromJson, duplicate-id rejection, returns List.of(..., growable:false) in file order.

Verification (ran from repo root): `flutter analyze lib/shared/models/landmark.dart lib/shared/models/route_result.dart` => No issues found. `flutter test test/landmark_test.dart test/route_result_test.dart` => All tests passed (13 tests; includes real-asset case asserting 6 landmarks, first id fort-santiago, route_node_id 1034882636, and ETA 150m=>2.0 plus unavailable-vs-zero-length distinction). No pubspec/package changes; no new directories beyond the four approved paths.
